from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extraction result for a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The exact title of the judgment document found in the text")
    case_types: list[str] = Field(description="The case category labels identified for this document (e.g., '执行案件', '民事案件')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo] = Field(description="List of extracted document information")
